statements.t: We expect that working capital requirements will continue to be funded through a combination of our existing funds, anticipated cash flow from operations, and further issuances of securities.
Our working capital requirements are expected to increase in line with the growth of our business.
Existing working capital, related party advances, and anticipated cash flow are not expected to be adequate to fund our operations over the next twelve months.

In connection with our business plan, management anticipates additional increases in operating expenses and capital expenditures relating to: (i) developmental expenses associated with a start-up business; and (ii) marketing expenses.
We intend to finance these expenses with anticipated cash flow from operations, further issuances of securities, and related party advances, if needed.

Management plans to address these conditions by continuing the sale of common stock under the Company’s registration statement, seeking additional customer engagements, and controlling operating costs; however, there can be no assurance that these plans will be successful.
